تستجني (form X)
# تَسْتَجِنِّي (tastajinnī) /tas.ta.d͡ʒin.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
# تُسْتَجَنِّي (tustajannī) /tus.ta.d͡ʒan.niː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجَنَّ (istajanna)
